Interpretation Act s. 26: 'Pacific Time' = 7 hours behind UTC, in force 2026-03-09 (B.C. Reg. 20/2026); boundary at 00:00 local (07:00 UTC). tzdata 2026b-2026e instead model PDT until 2026-11-01 02:00 and 'MST' afterwards (temporary hack for CLDR 48.1): the UTC offset is -07:00 on both sides, only isdst/abbreviation differ, so this is not an offset divergence. Microsoft MC1479468 also dates the change 2026-11-01.

MST/MDT on Canada rules (Daylight Saving Time Act, replaced in 2026; text not retrieved, rule per tzdata 2026e). Regime already in force on 2019-01-01, the start of this dataset's coverage; earlier history is not recorded here.

Official Time Act s. 1: UTC-6, no DST, in force 2026-06-18 (OC 204/2026; boundary 00:00 local assumed = 06:00 UTC). tzdata 2026c-2026e keep MDT until 2026-11-01 02:00 then CST: same -06:00 offset, only isdst/abbreviation differ. Also used by Lloydminster, East Kootenay/Golden (BC) and Yellowknife (link).

Northwest Territories Time Regulations R-090-2026 s. 1: standard time six hours behind UTC, in force 2026-08-21 (boundary 00:00 local = 06:00 UTC). tzdata 2026d+ model MDT until 2026-11-01 02:00 then CST (same offset); tzdata 2026c had the change only as comments and still falls back to -07 on 2026-11-01.

The Official Time Act s. 2: Central Standard Time with DST from the 2nd Sunday in March to the 1st Sunday in November. Regime already in force on 2019-01-01, the start of this dataset's coverage; earlier history is not recorded here.

The Official Time Amendment Act (S.M. 2023, c. 4) comes into force 2026-10-31 by proclamation of 2026-09-23 (boundary 00:00 local CDT = 05:00 UTC); Manitoba stays on UTC-5 and does not fall back on 2026-11-01. Not yet in force on 2026-10-04 (status enacted_not_effective). tzdata 2026e models CDT until 2026-11-01 02:00 then EST: same -05:00 offset. NW Ontario areas on this zone are assumed by tzdata to follow (UNVERIFIED).

Ley 7354 art. 1: UTC-3 nationwide; art. 2: in force from the first Sunday of October 2024 (2024-10-06, boundary 00:00 local -04 = 04:00 UTC). tzdata treats 2024-10-06..14 as DST and standard -03 only from 2024-10-15 (constitutional non-retroactivity): same offset, isdst differs.
